item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Fluid Relay
item.description:
Azure Fluid Relay will be retired on February 2, 2027. After that date, the service will be unavailable and workloads depending on it may be disrupted; the Fluid Framework remains available as open source.

  • Source: Azure Updates
